title: To Lie or Not to Lie? Investigating The Biased Spread of Global Lies by LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Translating identical misinformation generation prompts into 8 different languages (from high-resource like English to low-resource like Igbo) and comparing the models' compliance and refusal rates across these languages.

Substituting country-specific entities (e.g., country names, political figures, and cities representing 195 different countries) into prompt templates to measure geographic disparities in how often LLMs comply with generating misinformation.

Performing a regression analysis to correlate country-level Human Development Index (HDI) scores with the models' misinformation generation rates, testing if models are more likely to generate harmful outputs for less developed regions.
